section: Andhra Pradesh - SC and ST population; major tribal groups (Chenchu, Koya, Savara, Yanadi, Yerukula) and PVTGs
subsections: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Scheduled Area Land Transfer Regulation 1 of 1959 was amended by which Regulation?
accepted.x: The AP Scheduled Area Land Transfer Regulation 1 of 1959 was amended by Regulation 1 of 1970.
accepted.tq: Use the precise year-and-number combination rather than relying on a broad date range.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to Regulation 1 of 1970 in the Scheduled Areas of Andhra Pradesh, consider the following statements:
1. It bars transfer of land from tribals to non-tribals.
2. It bars transfer of land between non-tribals in Scheduled Areas.
3. It permits private mining firms to lease Scheduled Area land without restriction.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Regulation 1 of 1970 bars transfers from tribals to non-tribals and also between non-tribals in Scheduled Areas. Statement 3 is incorrect; the Samatha judgment barred leasing Scheduled Area land to non-tribals and private mining firms.
accepted.tq: Find the one statement that reverses the protective character of the land-transfer regulation.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the recent legal status of the AP Scheduled Area Land Transfer Regulation is correct?
o: The Regulation has been upheld exclusively by the Andhra Pradesh High Court without any Supreme Court proceedings.
The Regulation applies only to transfers between tribals and excludes all non-tribal transactions.
The Regulation was repealed after the Samatha judgment and no challenge is pending.
Draft amendments have been prepared, while a challenge to the Regulation is pending in the Supreme Court.
accepted.x: Draft amendments have been prepared, and a challenge to the Regulation is pending in the Supreme Court. The Regulation also covers transfers between non-tribals in Scheduled Areas.
accepted.tq: Separate the current legal developments from the historical rule and identify the precise institutional status.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: A dispute concerning an Eluru hamlet under Regulations 1/59 and 1/70 is pending before which court?
accepted.x: The dispute over an Eluru hamlet under Regulations 1/59 and 1/70 is before the Andhra Pradesh High Court.
accepted.tq: Apply the institutional-location trap by distinguishing the pending Supreme Court challenge from the Eluru dispute.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The principal effect of the Samatha judgment of 1997 was to:
o: transfer control of Scheduled Areas to district municipalities
reserve all Scheduled Area teacher posts for local STs
bar leasing Scheduled Area land to non-tribals and private mining firms
permit bauxite mining after approval by private companies
accepted.x: The Samatha judgment of 1997 barred leasing Scheduled Area land to non-tribals and private mining firms.
accepted.tq: Match the judgment with its specific legal consequence rather than with the later teacher-post order.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about G.O. No. 3:
1. It was issued in 2000.
2. It provided 100% of Scheduled Area teacher posts to local Scheduled Tribes.
3. It was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: G.O. No. 3 was issued in 2000, provided all Scheduled Area teacher posts to local STs, and was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2020.
accepted.tq: Combine date, content and judicial outcome; all three statements are supported.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Supreme Court struck down G.O. No. 3
B. G.O. No. 3 provided 100% of Scheduled Area teacher posts to local STs
C. Samatha judgment
D. Tribal bandh in ASR demanding replacement of G.O. No. 3
accepted.x: The sequence is Samatha judgment in 1997, G.O. No. 3 in 2000, its striking down in 2020, and the ASR tribal bandh in 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the 2000 and 2020 developments between them.

accepted.s: A tribal bandh in ASR on 8 August 2026 primarily demanded:

closure of all forest areas to tribal residents
accepted.x: The bandh held in ASR on 8 August 2026 demanded a replacement for G.O. No. 3, which had been struck down in 2020.

accepted.s: Bauxite deposits associated with the tribal-rights controversy in Andhra Pradesh lie in which areas?
accepted.x: The bauxite deposits lie in the Araku, Paderu and Chintapalli agency areas and raise concerns relating to PVTG rights.
accepted.tq: Use location matching and reject nearby but unrelated places in the same regional context.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding bauxite-related activity in the Agency areas:
1. The Centre allowed mining surveys in the Agency.
2. Soil sampling took place in Chintapalli and G.K. Veedhi.
3. The CPI(M) alleged that the activity bypassed the PESA Gram Sabhas and the Tribal Advisory Council.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: surveys were allowed, soil sampling occurred in Chintapalli and G.K. Veedhi, and the CPI(M) alleged that PESA Gram Sabhas and the TAC were bypassed.
accepted.tq: Check each institutional and geographical detail separately before selecting the combined code.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The statement that “nothing would be done against tribal interests” in the bauxite-related controversy was made by the:
o: Chairman of the Tribal Advisory Council
accepted.x: The Chief Minister stated that nothing would be done against tribal interests in connection with the bauxite issue.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a government assurance from the criticism made by a political party.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Polavaram project:
1. About 276 villages, mostly tribal, are expected to be submerged.
2. The affected villages are located mainly in ASR and Eluru.
3. Koya and Kondh groups oppose the displacement.
4. The CPI(M) stated that 21% of displaced families had received rehabilitation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. About 276 villages, mostly tribal and situated in ASR and Eluru, are to be submerged; Koya and Kondh groups oppose displacement, and the CPI(M) reported rehabilitation for only 21% of displaced families.
accepted.tq: Read the numerical percentage and the affected groups together; the four statements form one complete factual cluster.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: What proportion of displaced families did the CPI(M) state had received rehabilitation in the Polavaram displacement context?
accepted.x: The CPI(M) stated that only 21% of displaced families had received rehabilitation.
accepted.tq: Use the exact percentage and beware of reversing “only 21%” into a majority figure.
accepted.sec: Tribal movements and issues in AP - bauxite mining, Polavaram displacement, land alienation (1/70 Regulation)  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Odisha has 13 PVTGs.
2. Andhra Pradesh has 12 PVTGs.
3. Bihar has 9 PVTGs.
4. The Bhil are India’s largest tribe.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: Odisha has 13 PVTGs, Andhra Pradesh 12, Bihar 9, and the Bhil are India’s largest tribe.
accepted.tq: Compare all entries in the numerical list before selecting the inclusive coded option.

accepted.s: Which of the following best represents the central conflict in the debates surrounding pumped storage, bauxite and Polavaram projects in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Conflict between coastal regulation and international maritime law
Conflict with the 1/70 Regulation, PESA and the Forest Rights Act
Conflict between the Union List and the Concurrent List over taxation
Conflict between municipal laws and the Constitution’s emergency provisions

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly identifies the special status of the Chenchus in Andhra Pradesh’s tribal context?
o: They are AP’s aboriginal and most-examined PVTG.
They constitute the largest PVTG population in Odisha.
They are the only tribal group affected by Polavaram displacement.
They are AP’s largest tribe but are not classified as a PVTG.
accepted.x: The Chenchus are described as Andhra Pradesh’s aboriginal and most-examined PVTG.
accepted.tq: Use the FIRST/LAST-style superlative carefully and distinguish it from population-size claims about other tribes.

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the distribution of Scheduled Tribe population in Census 2011 is correct?
o: Araku had the most STs, and the district is now known as Paderu.
Visakhapatnam had the most STs, and the district is now known as ASR.
ASR had the most STs, and the district was earlier known as Eluru.
Eluru had the most STs, and the district is now known as Tajangi.
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam had the most STs in Census 2011; the relevant district is now identified as ASR.
accepted.tq: Separate the historical Census reference from the present district name and avoid swapping neighbouring locations.
